title: Delta's Best Product Isn't a Plane Ticket
description:
Delta's Best Product Isn't a Plane Ticket.

Sources:
- Delta 2025 results: Amex remuneration $8.2B (AltexSoft): https://www.altexsoft.com/travel-industry-news/premium-strategy-works-deltas-2025-revenue-hits-63b/
- Delta cards ~13% of Amex billed business (View from the Wing): https://viewfromthewing.com/amex-pays-delta-3-8-cents-per-dollar-charged-why-banks-pay-more-for-miles-than-you-do/

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Delta's most valuable product might not be a plane ticket.
In 2025, American Express paid Delta 8.2 billion dollars.

visual.label: paid to Delta by American Express, 2025

scenes.narration: Every time someone uses a Delta Amex card, at the grocery store, for gas, anywhere, Amex buys SkyMiles from Delta to reward them.
Delta cards make up about 13 percent of all the spending on American Express cards worldwide.

visual.label: of Amex's worldwide spending is on Delta cards

scenes.narration: And selling miles doesn't need fuel, pilots, or planes. It's some of the highest margin money an airline can make. Follow for more.
